annotations.title: Check an agent before calling it

description: Read-only check of one agent from our latest tests: result per role, score items out of 100, how accuracy was checked, whether it is a verified pearl, test time, response fingerprint, verified alternatives for the same role and, if one is offered, a necklace for the job. Give agent_id or url. Ads: one "Advertisement" in a separate `sponsored` array, also in `_meta["biz.agentconcierge/sponsored"]` and a last "Advertisement:" text line; results unchanged.
name: verify_agent

outputSchema.description: Fields vary by operation; check isError and status first.

direct_only.description: Not run by this gateway; not a recommendation.

sponsored.description: One labelled Advertisement, apart from the results; `disclosure` says paid or house. It does not affect ranking, selection or test results.

visitor.description: Session transport only; never put it in answer text.
